{{Quote|Chief of State Cal Omas today authorized new emergency measures to crack down on continuing unrest in Galactic City. Corel-Man passport holders now have forty-eight hours to report to their local CSF precinct and opt for repatriation or face internment. The move has been condemned by Senate representatives from Altyr Five, Obreedan, and Katraasii.|HNE lunchtime news bulletin|<ref name="Bloodlines" />}}
'''Altyr V''' or '''Altyr Five''' was the fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Altyr system/Legends|Altyr system]]. Like many other [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] worlds, it saw combat during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. By [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the  [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] operated a [[Altyr V base|base]] on Altyr V, and the rocky planet faced assault once more when the [[Dark Empire]] [[Battle of Altyr V (Galactic Civil War)|assaulted]] the base with [[Imperial artificial asteroids]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kyle Katarn]] and his [[Reciprocal apprenticeship|co-learner]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] fended off Imperial forces, while the New Republic evacuated. By [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], Altyr V joined the [[Confederation]] after the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]]s raids on [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] citizens on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Description==
Altyr V, a rocky, terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]], was and orbited by at least two [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="MOS" /> The fifth world in the [[Altyr system/Legends|Altyr system]] was fuether located in the [[Morshdine sector/Legends|Morshdine sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]],<ref name="EAOC" /> while overlapping the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]]<ref name="Atlas" />. [[Human/Legends|Humans]] on Altyr V breathed the world's [[Atmosphere/Legends|Type I]] [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] mix air.<ref name="MOS" />

==History==
===The Clone Wars===
Seceding to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] amidst the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Atlas" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Altyr V was the site of a brutal [[Battle of Altyr V|battle]] during which [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone commander]] [[Deviss/Legends|Deviss]] and his forces destroyed the Separatist [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] established on planet. With the cannon inactive the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was able to rout the Separatist forces off planet.<ref name="Insider-84" />

===Operation Shadowhand===
{{Quote|Kyle, we need you back at Ops! They've got us pinned down!|[[Unidentified New Republic commander|New Republic commander]]|<ref name="MOS" />}}
[[File:Altyr V Landing Cliff.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Altyr V base's landing platform]]
As the Empire became more destabilized at the close of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="Atlas" /> the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] established a base on the rocky Altyr V.<ref name="MOS" />  In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kyle Katarn]] was stationed on the planet acting as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] along with his [[Reciprocal apprenticeship|fellow Jedi]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]. Among the New Republic personnel, the base held Jade's ship, the ''[[Shrike (Alpha-52 starfighter)|Shrike]]'', a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter|Y-wing]], and three [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]].  While there, Katarn discovered ancient runes that led to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] planet [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]],<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|210|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> 

[[File:Artisteroid.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Katarn returns from an Imperial asteroid moments before its implosion.]]
During [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] training, the [[Dark Empire]] began an [[Battle of Altyr V (Galactic Civil War)|assault]] on the planet. The Republic leadership discovered two [[Imperial artificial asteroids]] in orbit, bombarding the base's shield and pinning the Republic forces down until a large-scale assault could be staged. After the ground force landed, Katarn stole one of their [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Imperial shuttles]] and infiltrated one of the asteroids. Onboard, he redirected its weapon to the other [[Asteroid/Legends|astreroid]], destroying it. He then forced the implosion of the other, barely escaping himself. Katarn left for the Dromund Kaas, feeling it call to him, while Jade and other New Republic forces evacuated the base.<ref name="MOS" />

===Second Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|The Empire's back! The Empire's back!|Coruscant protesters|<ref name="Bloodlines" />}}
Following the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]'s end in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>, Altyr V was granted membership and representation in the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]]. During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], representatives from Altyr V condemned the actions of the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]]s raids on [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] citizens on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Bloodlines" /> By [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], Altyr V left the Galactic Alliance with [[Katraasii]] and other worlds to join the [[Confederation]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
Altyr V first appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''.<ref name="MOS" /> It was later charted to O-5 on a map at  of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] in the [[2009]] reference book''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Atlas" />
